info.title: FlightFinder Aviation Safety Data API
info.description:
Read-only JSON API over FlightFinder's merged aviation-safety corpus: accident narratives aggregated from 120+ official investigation agencies, deduplicated into one occurrence-level dataset with derived family analytics.

Authentication: `Authorization: Bearer YOUR_KEY`. The key must travel in the header — `?api_key=` is rejected with 401 `query_key_unsupported`, because query strings end up in access logs and browser history.

Getting a key: keys belong to a himaxym.com account. Sign in, then `POST /keys` with your account's JWT in `Authorization: Bearer` — the response carries the raw API key exactly once (only a hash is stored). Up to 5 active keys per account; `DELETE /keys/{id}` frees a slot.

No key required to start: every GET data endpoint answers without any Authorization header at the keyless tier, 100 requests/day/IP.

Rate limits: no key — 100 requests/day/IP; free key — 1000/day and 60/minute; pro key — 20000/day and 60/minute. Daily quotas reset at UTC midnight; 429 responses carry a `Retry-After` header (seconds — time to UTC midnight for the daily quota, up to 60 for the per-minute limiter). A newly created key, or an upgrade to pro, can take up to 5 minutes to be visible to every worker.

Licensing: facts and merged/derived data are always returned in full. `narrative_text` is full for open-licensed sources (CC, OGL, Licence Ouverte/Etalab, public domain) and an ~300-char excerpt plus a `source_url` deep link otherwise — see `GET /sources` for the per-source policy. Every record carries `source`, `attribution`, `license` and a deep link; visible attribution is required when displaying or republishing.

post.description: Send your himaxym.com account JWT as the bearer token — NOT an API key. Returns the raw key exactly once; only a hash is stored. Up to 5 active keys per account (409 `key_limit` beyond that); the /keys routes accept 30 requests per 15 minutes per IP.

label.description: A name for the key (your app or project).

201.description: Key created — store `key` now, it is never shown again.

409.description: `key_limit` — 5 active keys already; revoke one with DELETE /keys/{id} first.

get.description: Account JWT as the bearer token. Never returns a secret — id, label and usage only.

delete.summary: Revoke one of your own API keys
delete.description: Account JWT as the bearer token. Owner-scoped: a key that is not yours answers 404, not 403.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque cursor — pass the previous page's next_cursor.

200.description: A page of occurrences with per-source attribution.

get.summary: One occurrence with sources and narrative refs
Narrative by source + the authority's own case id
get.description: narrative_text is full for open-licensed sources, an ~300-char excerpt + source_url deep link otherwise (policy field on GET /sources). Published article rewrites appear as a first-paragraph excerpt + canonical_url; pro keys also receive full_text under the no-public-republication license. Case ids containing '/' must be URL-encoded.

get.summary: Family safety stats from the merged corpus

200.description: Family info, ICAO type list, and merged-corpus stats.

get.summary: FAA wildlife strike database — global aggregates (US-gov public domain)

200.description: Hub rollups: totals, by-year, top airports/species, and notable strikes with FAA narrative remarks.

get.summary: FAA wildlife strikes for one airport

parameters.name: slug
parameters.description: Airport slug (lowercased ICAO/FAA id, e.g. kden).

200.description: Per-airport totals, top species, and notable strikes.

get.summary: FAA wildlife strikes for one species

200.description: Per-species totals, top airports, and notable strikes.

get.summary: FAA reported laser incidents — global aggregates (US-gov public domain)

200.description: Hub rollups: totals, injuries, by-year, top states/colors/airports.

get.summary: FAA laser incidents for one US state

200.description: Per-state totals, injuries, and top cities.

get.summary: FAA laser incidents near one airport

200.description: Per-airport totals, injuries, and top cities.

get.summary: FAA UAS (drone) sighting reports — global aggregates (US-gov public domain)

200.description: Hub rollups: totals, by-year, top states/cities, and recent report narratives.

get.summary: FAA drone sightings for one US state

200.description: Per-state totals, top cities, and recent report narratives.

get.summary: Airport reference lookup by ICAO ident or IATA code (OurAirports, CC0)

parameters.name: ident
parameters.description: ICAO ident (e.g. KDEN, EGLL) or 3-letter IATA code (e.g. DEN).

200.description: Airport name, city, country, IATA/ICAO codes, and coordinates.
Every source: code, name, license, homepage, narrative count, policy.

bearerKey.description: API key as a bearer token. On the /keys management routes this is the account JWT instead — the API key itself cannot create or revoke keys.

Occurrence.description: Occurrence facts (always full) + per-source attribution. The detail endpoint adds narratives[] refs.

AccountAuthRequired.description: The /keys management routes need your himaxym.com ACCOUNT JWT, not an API key. Note the body shape differs from the data endpoints: `{"success": false, "message": "Unauthorized"}`.

RateLimited.description: Rate limit exceeded — retry after the Retry-After header (seconds).
